newsitem.title: USA: Pro-Fac unit names new president.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Fac unit names new president.

text.p: Pro-Fac Cooperative said on Thursday its Curtice Burns subsidiary named Chief Operating Officer Dennis Mullen, 42, as president and chief executive officer, effective January 3, 1997.
Mullen would replace Roy Myers, 65, who would retire on that date, the company said.

Pro-Fac is an agricultural marketing cooperative, and Curtice Burns processes and markets a variety of product lines or regional branded, private label and foodservice products in facilities through the United States.
